payload.text: Determinism rule — `norm_cdf` computes the standard-normal CDF as `0.5 * libm::erfc(-x * INV_SQRT_2)`, routing the transcendental through `rust-lang/libm` (correctly-rounded) rather than the platform libm, so the result is bit-identical across targets (the cross-platform determinism guarantee of docs/INTERFACES.md). Using the complementary error function `erfc` on `-x·1/√2` keeps the deep left tail stable (no catastrophic cancellation), which is why the tail tests pass. f64 is the CPU-canonical scalar. Pure: maps one f64 to one f64 via libm, no side effects, no state.
